shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/catalog/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; git diff package.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rli "prefetch" . | head -40; echo ---; grep -rn "searchParams" --include=*.md . | grep -i "prefetch" | head -30

cat 01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md; echo ======; sed -n 1,80p 01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md; echo ======; cat 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/03-route-segment-config/prefetch.md 2>/dev/null | head -80 || find . -name "prefetch.md"
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

git diff tsconfig.json | head -30; grep -rho "next-router-prefetch[^'\"]*\|NEXT_ROUTER_PREFETCH[A-Z_]*\|NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH[A-Z_]*\|NEXT_ROUTER_STATE_TREE[A-Z_]*\|NEXT_ROUTER_RUNTIME[A-Z_]*" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js | sort -u; cat node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js | head -60

grep -rln "NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER" node_modules/next/dist/client/ | head; f=$(grep -rl "NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache*/cache.js | head -1); echo "FILE $f"; grep -n "headers\[\|HEADER\] = \|isRuntimePrefetch\|runtime" "$f" | head -40

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:3123/ && break; sleep 1; done; echo "--- runtime prefetch (prefetch={true}) for category=sale:"; curl -s 'http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale' -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' | grep -o 'Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Loading category\|Featured products' | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- runtime prefetch for category=featured:"; curl -s 'http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=featured' -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' | grep -o 'Products on sale\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket\|Loading category\|Featured products' | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- default app-shell prefetch (for comparison):"; curl -s 'http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=sale' -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 3' | grep -o 'Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Loading category' | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace; check() { echo "--- $1 (Next-Router-Prefetch: $2)"; curl -sL "http://localhost:3123/catalog?category=$1" -H 'RSC: 1' -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: $2" | grep -o 'Products on sale\|Featured products\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket\|Loading category' | sort | uniq -c; }; check sale 2; check featured 2; echo; echo "=== app-shell prefetch for comparison"; check sale 3
cd /workspace; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'href="[^"]*"'; pkill -f "next start -p 3123"; git status --short
cd /workspace; sleep 1; pgrep -fl "next start" || echo "server stopped"; git status --short; git diff -- next.config.ts app/page.tsx lib/data.ts
